metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata to attach to every chunk (e.g. source URL, document ID).

overlap_tokens.description: Token overlap between consecutive chunks for context continuity (default 50, max 512).

text.description: Document text to prepare (plain text, Markdown, or lightly-structured prose). Max 500,000 chars.

Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.194 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Prepares a document for question-answering and RAG pipelines. Chunks the input text at paragraph/sentence boundaries, assigns deterministic chunk IDs, estimates token counts, and extracts document metadata (word count, type, headings). Returns ready-to-embed chunks with overlap support. No LLM or external API — pure text processing. Use mid-task when you've fetched a document and need it split before querying a vector store.
